body: Atlantic Airways, the national airline of the Faroe Islands, has signed a firm order with Airbus for two A320neo aircraft. The order supports the airline's transition toward an all-A320neo fleet, which Airbus says will bring operational synergies and streamlined maintenance.

The airline currently operates four A320 Family aircraft, comprising two A320ceo and two A320neo. Atlantic Airways says the agreement marks a significant step toward operating an exclusively A320neo fleet in the near future, while Airbus says the additional aircraft reinforce the airline's commitment to regional connectivity for Faroese communities. Airbus notes the A320 Family has won more than 20,400 orders worldwide and offers at least 20% fuel savings and CO2 reduction compared with previous-generation single-aisle aircraft.
en.summary: Faroe Islands flag carrier Atlantic Airways has signed a firm order for two Airbus A320neo aircraft, moving toward an all-A320neo fleet.
en.title: Atlantic Airways orders two additional Airbus A320neo aircraft

body: 法羅群島國家航空大西洋航空已與空中巴士簽署確定訂單，購買2架A320neo客機。這筆訂單支持航空公司朝全A320neo機隊轉型，有助帶來營運綜效並簡化維修作業。
大西洋航空目前營運4架A320家族客機，包括2架A320ceo與2架A320neo。大西洋航空表示，這項協議是邁向近期營運全A320neo機隊的重要一步；空中巴士則表示，新增客機將強化航空公司對法羅群島地區連結的承諾。空中巴士表示，A320家族全球已獲得逾20,400架訂單，相較上一代單走道客機，燃油節省與二氧化碳減排至少達20%。
zh.summary: 法羅群島國家航空大西洋航空與空中巴士簽署確定訂單，再訂購2架A320neo，推動機隊全面轉向A320neo。
zh.title: 法羅群島大西洋航空再訂2架A320neo，邁向全A320neo機隊
